item.description:
Controller 1.0.48 (57) ships unified macOS, iOS, Apple Watch, and Android updates.
- Add in-app and remote harness controls to check for updates, install updates, and restart harnesses across Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode 2 (including restarting the OpenCode background service), Factory Droid, Grok, Pi, Cursor, and Antigravity. - Expose harness version, update checks, updates, and restarts in Settings → Harnesses, the sidebar connection popover, the Mac/iOS/Android configuration sheet, Mac Connect settings, mobile environment details, and the `manage_harnesses` orchestration tool. - Strip OpenCode plugin `<system-reminder>` blocks from visible user message text. - Restore Android notification isolation and live transcript virtualization, and limit Android glass input to overlapping transcript rows.
iOS and Apple Watch use the same 1.0.48 (57) build uploaded to App Store Connect. Availability through TestFlight or the App Store depends on Apple's processing and review.

Controller 1.0.47 (56) unifies the macOS, iOS, Apple Watch, and Android version and build numbers.
- One release now includes the Mac installer DMG, full Sparkle update, delta from build 53, and signed Android APK. - Fix initial Mac workspace rendering and reduce sidebar refresh, preference synchronization, and mobile hangs. - Improve Android inbox, conversation chrome, activity, host wake/reconnect, model settings, Git tools, attachments, links, approvals, and queued prompts. - Android updates now support the shared release tag while preserving signed-feed, APK identity, and checksum verification.
Android builds 55 and earlier require a one-time manual installation of this APK to adopt the shared release URLs. Existing installation data is preserved when upgrading with the same signing key. Android Connect behavior remains subject to live-device validation; this release's checks do not establish new live-host integration coverage.
iOS and Apple Watch use the same 1.0.47 (56) build uploaded to App Store Connect. Availability through TestFlight or the App Store depends on Apple's processing and review.

## Controller 1.0.46 (53)
- **Native composer plan chip morph:** The composer's task plan chip now shows a compact `Step N/M` pill (`Plan complete` when finished) that morphs smoothly into a `Plan · Step N/M` card over all steps using Liquid Glass matched-geometry transitions across macOS and iOS while preserving keyboard focus (`Space` and `Return`). - **ControllerMobile sidebar & foldable polish:** Placed the sidebar search trigger beside `Settled` and `New Chat` and kept the split view clear of the iPhone Duo fold. - **Connect & host hardening:** Hardened per-host model catalogs, Windows host/tunnel resilience, and remote RPC dispatch for mobile companions.
